task.description: Implement QRY-01, QRY-02, QRY-03, QRY-04 per the design artefact src/design/qry-01-04-entity-query.md on branch feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818. Implement: (1) POST /api/v1/entities/{entity_key}/query handler in Zig; (2) FilterOp enum with eq/neq/lt/lte/gt/gte/in/contains ops; (3) FilterNode and SortNode types; (4) EntityQueryRequest and EntityQueryResponse types (with page_size: u16); (5) EntityAllowlist / loadAllowlist using entity_definitions table; (6) Query compiler that emits parameterised SQL (no string concatenation — all values positional, column refs from allowlist only); (7) Keyset cursor (opaque, base64url, sort-fingerprint validation); (8) emptyEnvelope constant {items:[],next_cursor:null,page_size:50} used for deny AND unknown entity_key paths; (9) EntityQueryExecuted audit event (entity_key, filter field names, row count — no filter values); (10) Migration 1152_qry_filterable_keys.sql for the allowlist table. Wire the new handler into the router. Run zig build to verify compilation. Commit to the feature branch.
critical_security_requirements: All filter values MUST be positional parameters ($1, $2, ...) — NO string concatenation
Operator/field names MUST come from the closed enum/allowlist only — never from client text
emptyEnvelope MUST be returned for both unauthorized and unknown entity_key (probe-safe)
Every compiled query MUST include WHERE tenant_id = $N
search_path MUST be set to caller's tenant schema before query execution

result.summary: Implemented QRY-01..04: (1) migration 1168_qry_filterable_keys.sql creates entity_filterable_keys per-tenant table (scope: tenant_only); (2) src/entities/query/types.zig defines FilterOp, SortDir, FilterNode, SortNode, EntityQueryRequest, EntityQueryResponse; (3) src/entities/query/allowlist.zig implements loadAllowlist/deinitAllowlist with built-in typed columns plus JSONB key rows; (4) src/entities/query/compiler.zig builds fully-parameterised SQL with all values as positional params, column refs from allowlist only, keyset cursor predicate; (5) src/entities/query/cursor.zig implements encodeCursor/decodeCursor/buildFingerprint using QE: prefix, 24h expiry, pipe-separated tuple; (6) src/api/routes/entity_query.zig implements handleEntityQuery with entity_key validation, entity registration check, emptyEnvelope for deny/unknown (QRY-04), allowlist load, compile, execute, next-cursor, audit; (7) POST /api/v1/entities/:entity_key/query wired in main.zig; (8) pre-existing obs/audit.zig build error (std.time.microTimestamp removed in Zig 0.16) fixed. zig build exits 0. Committed as 951e44a1.
